final_assessment:
Consume-mode promotion of a Mature exploration: 7 decisions and zero open questions in, four artifacts out. Q-rc04c-b was RESOLVED at Step 0b rather than deferred as a marker — it moved into Decisions as D-rc04c-7, so the exploration went to zero open questions before generation rather than shipping a marker into design.md.

The deltas were BUILT FROM BASELINE BY SCRIPT (rc04d's technique): all 9 requirement blocks extracted fence-aware and verbatim, then edited site by site, so every difference from baseline is deliberate rather than a retyping artifact. 22 sites across 3 capabilities. FIVE mentions of `gate_overridden` survive in the deltas ON PURPOSE and none is normative — verified by grepping the survivors against SHALL/MUST/REQUIRED, which returns nothing. They are prior-generation narration, and they have to exist: 20 archived emits carry the field, and specs that never named it could not say those trails remain readable. This is a DIFFERENT exit criterion from rc04d's, whose delta-scope grep had to read ZERO, and tasks 4's AT-ARCHIVE NOTE states the distinction so the post-sync measurement counts NORMATIVE naming rather than raw occurrences.

The substantive spec work is the edge that closes. `orbit-archive-modifications` carried a paragraph titled THE ONE EDGE WHERE THE SUCCESSOR CANNOT BE WRITTEN — the no-independent-pass case, where `formed_against`'s unconditional non-empty rule meant the legacy field stood alone. D-rc04c-1's totality rule closes it, so that paragraph is rewritten as an edge that now CAN be written, the successor becomes TOTAL over the override's domain, and 'strict widening' becomes true rather than nearly true. One scenario flipped with it (the entry is now written with an empty `formed_against` rather than omitted), and the old unconditional refusal scenario split into three covering accept, refuse-naming-the-pass, and the scope guard on readiness/spend.

Read-before-reference paid off once materially: before writing the apply-side deltas I checked whether `continuation` is admitted on the apply emit at all, because if the successor were archive-only, retiring the field at apply would have been data LOSS rather than a move. `orbit-run-summary-emit`'s closed three-emit table admits it. Had that gone the other way the stage would have needed rescoping.

design.md carries one decision the exploration did not: D4 runs the blind pair AFTER apply rather than before, settled under R-crc-3 and recorded because Q-crc-20 makes the timing consequential. rc04d's walk deleted the very sentence its pair had reviewed, and that was a prose-only stage; this one touches the engine, three bodies and four test files, so the gap is wider by construction. The accepted cost is that findings arrive when the code exists. D5 records that no deprecation path is needed for the payload key — the composing bodies and the rejecting table ship in one commit, and orbit is single-user, so a version skew cannot occur.

Tasks are ordered so the engine accepts a legal empty BEFORE the bodies stop writing the legacy object; the reverse order would make any apply or archive run between the two commits refuse its own emit. Section 3 preserves D-rc04c-6's three-kinds classification rather than flattening it to 'fix 4 test files', including the fixture-only swap that carries no semantic content. Section 4 carries a DESCOPE SWEEP task under R-crc-6's corollary, which is the defect class this stage is most exposed to.

Validation clean, 9/9 base fingerprints stamped and re-verified after the move. Staged metadata merged generically with the fresh-owned denylist (schema/created/schema_version); `architecture` carried forward with no conflicts. Staging directory removed, trail preserved (4 emits). PR regime resolved `never`, so that section returned immediately — no probe, no note, no tail.
